title: StockSmart Logistics Table — Route Delivery Cover Weeks for a Consigned Bin Taking Over a VendPoint Item
content:
The fill-to level of a new consigned StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin that takes over an item the customer has had taken out of one of its VendPoint machines carries extra cover where the program's ship-to sees few route trucks.

**Rule.** The program's ship-to adds cover weeks for the route truck deliveries its service level schedules each week: a ship-to with no route deliveries adds 1 week, a ship-to with 1 or 2 route deliveries a week adds 0.5 week, and a ship-to with 3 or more adds none; a ship-to whose service level is not on record adds none.

The figure read is the route deliveries per week that the service level of the program's ship-to, held as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account, schedules.

| Route deliveries per week scheduled by the ship-to's service level | Cover weeks added |
|---|---|
| 0 (no route service) | 1 week |
| 1 | 0.5 week |
| 2 | 0.5 week |
| 3 or more | none |
| service level not on record | none; the ship-to is treated as one with 7 route deliveries a week |

**Boundary.** 2 route deliveries a week is the last figure that adds 0.5 week; 3 adds nothing.
